title: Search Rule
description: Defines the ordered sequence of zones to search for matching stock, and how to select among candidates within each zone, for a given item/category scope. Does not itself search live inventory - see README 'What this repo is not'.

item_id.description: References an id in MasterData-as-Code. More specific than category - takes precedence when both a category-scoped and an item-scoped rule could match the same item.

applies_to.description: Scopes this rule to a category or a specific item. Omit entirely for this building's default/fallback rule - exactly one search_rule per building should omit applies_to, see tools/validate.py.

steps.description: Ordered search sequence: step 1 is tried first, later steps are fallbacks only consulted if earlier steps don't yield enough quantity. Whether/how quantity found across multiple steps combines into one pick or is split into several sub-orders is OrderOrchestration-as-Code's split_rule concern, not this repo's.
